notes.title: 🚀 v1.4.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] The virtual keyboard is now supported in Big Picture Mode and on the Steam Deck, making text input more convenient on those platforms.
[/list]

[h2]🔁 Quality of Life[/h2]

[list]
[*] When returning from a puzzle match, the Home screen will now be open with the last story and picture you selected, so you can pick up right where you left off.
[/list]

[h2]🎨 Visual Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Leaderboard entry button is now bigger and more visually appealing.
[*] Added particle effects to highlight the top 3 ranks (1st, 2nd, 3rd) on the Leaderboard.
[*] Introduced particle effects on the "Ranking" label below the difficulty selection.
[*] Added informational text explaining what the Ranked difficulties mean.
[/list]

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual issue when scrolling through the picture selection screen.
[/list]

notes.title: 🚀 v1.4.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
We are excited to release [b]version 1.4.0[/b] of our game, featuring a special Easter story for you to enjoy!

[hr][/hr]  
[h2][b]✨ Easter: From Prototype to Tetelestai ✨[/b][/h2]  
Dive into the powerful connection between the first Passover and the ultimate sacrifice of Christ.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175893/fade880b8739021e850c4fdc28065a605192a268.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]  
[h2][b]🏆 Leaderboards[/b][/h2]  
New story, new visuals, and brand-new Ranked leaderboards. The earlier you jump in, the better your chances to top the charts.

[hr][/hr]  
[h2][b]📱 Mobile[/b][/h2]  
Don't forget, you can also play our game on your mobile phone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175893/66700ba64856ec8230a72bda1defbef6fce42a92.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]  
[h2][b]🧩 What’s Next?[/b][/h2]  
📚 We paused the story of David to bring you this Easter release first. His journey is now nearly complete. Discover the tale of a young shepherd with the courage to face a giant!

[hr][/hr]  
[h2][b]💬 Feedback and Community[/b][/h2]  
Do you have suggestions or questions? Join our community and share your thoughts!

👉 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3175310/discussions/]Visit our community forums on Steam[/url]

[hr][/hr]  
We hope you are enjoying the game. See you on the [b]Leaderboards[/b]! 🎉

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🚀 v1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of version 1.1.0 of our game! This update introduces several important features that allow you to play across devices and platforms, along with a new captivating video featuring the story of Moses. Here's what's new:

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🌟 New Anime Video:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have completed and added a new video story about Moses! This video is crafted with love and features a vibrant Anime-style vibe. We hope you enjoy this new approach to storytelling.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175893/a9f343811f6281fac0e83817ba585419a20b8632.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🔑 Account Management:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Google Account Integration:[/b] Connect your game to your Google Account to seamlessly carry your progress across platforms and devices.
[*] [b]Steam Account Disconnection:[/b] You can now disconnect your Steam Account if needed, offering you more control over your account.
[*] [b]Code-Link Feature:[/b] Use a unique Code-Link system to transfer your game progress to other devices or platforms.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175893/aa01181b4728d122bb44de1855121f6b2ed6f9f9.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🏆 Leaderboard Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards now show player avatars, platforms, and country information, making it more interactive and engaging.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175893/2cdcdd1ef025e405679d2cbc100d99bb4042c111.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎖️ Achievements Update:[/h2]

[b]We heard your feedback loud and clear!☺️[/b]
[list]
[*] To make achievements more enjoyable, we’ve removed overly difficult ones and rebalanced the way they unlock.
[*] Unlock achievements by visiting Google Play or the App Store simply by clicking their buttons in the Settings menu.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175893/491b7f30790a59e2d786cd34ac02f8e1f4f925ac.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📱 Google Play App:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game is now available on Google Play as a free-to-play app with optional in-app purchases for story packs.
[*] [b]Steam players:[/b] If you've already made progress on a story on Steam, you won’t need to repurchase it on Google Play.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📝 Change Your Player Name:[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now personalize your player name! Simply click on your name at the top-left corner of the Home screen to edit it.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175893/2bda996dfb05fceec41c8492c1c99419fa75f78f.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧩 Game Name Update:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Based on player feedback, we’ve updated the game’s name in English. The term “Jigsaw” has been removed to avoid confusion, as the game pieces are not traditional jigsaw-style pieces. Thank you for your feedback! 😅
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🗨️ Feedback and Community:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Have a suggestion ou question for us? Open a discussion in our community here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3175310/discussions/]Community Discussions[/url]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧩 What’s Coming Next?[/h2]
[b]David and Daniel Stories:[/b]
[list]
[*] We are beginning work on new pictures and videos for the stories of David and Daniel! Stay tuned for updates as we bring these incredible tales to life.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

We hope you enjoy all the exciting new updates in this release! Your feedback is always welcome and helps us improve the game for everyone. Thank you for being part of our community! ❤️

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🚀 1.0.0 - Full Game Release
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that version 1.0.0 marks the official release of our game on Steam! To celebrate, we’re offering a 35% discount for the first 7 days.

As a thank you to everyone who played our Demo version:
- All progress made in the Demo will carry over to the full game.
- Achievements earned (except those related to playtime) will be automatically credited when you start the full game.

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ranking:[/b] Compete at the top of the rankings on [b]Normal[/b], [b]Hard[/b], and [b]Very Hard[/b] difficulty levels.
[*] [b]Cloud Progress:[/b] Your progress is now automatically saved to the cloud, allowing you to pick up where you left off on any future device, including mobile versions.
[*] Two new images were added to Noah's scroll.
[*] Two new images were added to Moses' scroll.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievements have been adjusted to better reflect puzzle difficulty.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Narrator volume is now adjusted by the music volume control in the settings menu.
[*] Fixed screen freezing when changing difficulty in the selection menu.
[*] Frame rate is now capped at 60 fps to ensure a smoother experience and protect your hardware. 😅
[/list]

[h1]🧩 What’s Next? 🧩[/h1]

Our initial goal was to launch the game with complete story narration for each scroll, similar to the narration in the First Day of Creation scroll. However, due to delays in developing the Achievement, Login, and Rankings systems, additional narrations are still in production.

We will continue working to add these missing narrations and expand the content with new images to enrich the stories.

We hope you enjoy and feel inspired by our game as you explore the narrated biblical stories created with care and dedication. 🙏🏽

May all Honor, Glory, and Power be given to the Lord Jesus forever! 🙌🏽

---
Marllon Vilano  
Or Games  
https://www.instagram.com/orgames_net/

notes.title: Demo v0.7.0 - Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175893/4a9f825612e955453ba7de9e81dbf5324649b637.gif[/img]

This will be perfect for players who love collecting rewards and challenging themselves with single-player goals. Play the game now and get all the achievements you earned by playing the previous versions.

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added more than 60 achievements.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the color of pieces when you move the mouse over them.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed pieces that were not clickable at the bottom part of the screen.
[/list]

[h1]🧩 What's Coming Next? 🧩[/h1]

We believe one of the key features that will keep everyone engaged is the challenge of moving up the rankings. You'll be able to compete with friends and players around the world on each puzzle. We're working on a ranking system that will be released in the Open Beta, allowing us to test it and get your feedback.

More content... At the moment we have only 5 Story Scrolls, and only the first of them has a video story to give you an idea of how it will work. On the release, all scrolls will have their own video story to give you context about what the pictures inside are about. Also, more scrolls and pictures will continue to be released inside the game from time to time.

notes.title: Demo v0.6.0 - Release Notes
notes.content:
We are excited to share the new improvements we've been working on over the past days.

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a button to show the full image during gameplay (using it costs one move).
[*] Pieces now change color when you move the mouse over them.
[*] Added a new custom mouse cursor.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lowered the starting volume to 30% to prevent it from being too loud when opening the game for the first time.
[*] The difficulty option is now hidden the first time you open the app.
[*] Improved how the game manages memory.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with UI elements on the Home and Settings menus.
[/list]

[h1]What's Coming Next?[/h1]

We believe one of the key features that will keep everyone engaged is the challenge of moving up the rankings. You'll be able to compete with friends and players around the world on each puzzle. We're working on a ranking system that will be released in the Open Beta, allowing us to test it and get your feedback.

Another exciting feature is Achievements. This will be perfect for players who love collecting rewards and challenging themselves with single-player goals.
